import asyncio

from seed import AsyncSeedPythonOptionalRequestBody, RefundRequest

client = AsyncSeedPythonOptionalRequestBody(
    base_url="https://yourhost.com/path/to/api",
)


async def main() -> None:
    await client.batch_refund(
        request=[
            RefundRequest(
                amount=1.1,
            ),
            RefundRequest(
                amount=1.1,
            ),
        ],
    )


asyncio.run(main())
